messages:
Jordan: forwarding customer report — Alex seeing SSE stream duplicate/truncated chunks when switching from cafe Wi‑Fi to phone hotspot. Customer also suspects double billing for the last token batch. Repro steps attached.

Alex: repro steps — start a long response, then switch network (WiFi -> phone hotspot). App shows `EventSource closed`, reconnects, then the last message either duplicates or is cut in half. Happens ~80% for me.

Alex: logs paste:
```
EventSource: readyState=1
received: data: {"id":"ev-123","chunk":"The quick brown ..."}
received: data: {"id":"ev-124","chunk":"fox jumps over"}
readyState=2 // closed
reconnect
received: data: {"id":"ev-124","chunk":"fox jumps over"}
received: data: {"id":"ev-125","chunk":"the lazy dog"}
```
Billing shows two charge rows for gen-789.

Jordan: can you confirm exact SDK version + platform? Also tagging eng. @Priya, any immediate thoughts?

Priya: thanks Jordan. Quick hypotheses: (1) client-side reconnect resends last-event without idempotency and server treats it as new (counts tokens), (2) token refresh / auth TTL might be racing with reconnect, causing the gateway to accept a resumed request as a fresh generation. Need server logs for conn id.

Jordan: copied server/gateway logs from time window and forwarded to oncall-bot.

Oncall Bot: found gateway trace: conn_id=abc123, client_ip before=192.168.43.21, after=100.64.0.23, proxied-by=corp-proxy(10.1.2.3). tcp_close_reason=ECONNRESET, upstream=redwood-inference-gw-7, proxied-status=502. No explicit auth failure.

Sam: NAT rebinding + corporate proxy in the path — when client IP flips mid-TCP, proxy tears TCP and creates a new connection. Our SSE gateway currently doesn't have a robust resume protocol — reconnect will create a fresh request which can re-trigger generation.

Priya: short-term mitigation for customer: (a) upgrade to SDK with resume support (v0.12.3+), which sends `Last-Event-ID`/`X-Resume-Event` so server can dedupe, (b) implement client-side logic: on network change, pause UI and attempt a soft resume with last_event_id instead of blind re-open, (c) make sure auth token refresh is performed off the streaming socket (refresh proactively).

Jordan: customer asks how they can reproduce locally so we can triage — Alex already provided steps but can you add a deterministic way?

Alex: local repro — use iPhone tethering: enable WiFi, start stream, then toggle Personal Hotspot on (or turn off WiFi) while receiving tokens. I've captured packet-level pcap and will share.

Priya: useful debug checklist for us to triage: 
- exact SDK + browser/native runtime + OS + network carrier
- `last_event_id` values from client logs
- server/gateway conn_id from corresponding time window (we have abc123 for one instance)
- any proxy/VPN in path (customer indicated corp-proxy in headers)

Sam: engineering quick patch we can apply to reduce duplicates: treat immediate reconnects with identical `last_event_id` + session token within 30s as idempotent — drop duplicate generation acceptance and return 200 with existing stream tail. I'll open PR to add a short-lived de‑dup cache keyed by (session_token, last_event_id).

Jordan: billing question — do duplicates bill?

Sam: currently our billing counts tokens accepted by the generation endpoint. If we accepted two generator requests and both produced tokens, they'd count twice. We can make an exception for confirmed platform-side duplicate caused by our gateway/proxy and issue credit. Need incidents/billing to confirm.

Jordan: action items summarized: 
1) Jordan -> ask Alex to try SDK v0.12.3 (resume header) and share pcap + exact env.
2) Priya/Sam -> implement short-term dedupe window on gateway and add logs for resume headers.
3) Sam -> flag billing for potential credit against gen-789 if we confirm duplicate acceptance.
4) Jordan -> follow up with customer in 24h with instructions and temporary workaround: increase keepalive to 15s, add client exponential backoff on reconnect, prefer resume header.

Alex: thanks, will test SDK and send pcap shortly. :thumbsup:

Priya: also note — mobile OS can aggressively close sockets on network change; recommend mobile app signal handler to buffer incomplete chunk assembly and avoid immediate retries.

Jordan: great. tagging this as high-priority escalation; I'll update ticket #5421 when we have results.

Sam: filing internal ticket INF-1245 for gateway de‑dup work and linking this thread.

Priya: thanks all.

Jordan: closing loop for now — will re-open if repro persists after SDK test. :white_check_mark:
